title: Spatial access to psychiatric home-visit nursing stations in Japan: code and aggregated results
description: Analysis code and aggregated municipality-level results for a nationwide cross-sectional study of geographic access to stations registered for psychiatric home-visit nursing in Japan, using the enhanced two-step floating catchment area (E2SFCA) method with a 30-minute catchment. Station-level data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
